parsed.note: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 only changes a training hyperparameter, leaves the fixed eval config (EVAL_SHARD 10, val split) untouched, and training shards 0-9 still exclude the evaluation data, so val_bpb remains a genuine out-of-sample measure.
